name: Ek Cheez Bolke Chaar Gina Raha Hai
visual_description: CarryMinati holds up four fingers with an annoyed expression in front of his YouTube play button wall.
usage_context: Used to call out someone who claims they will do or say only one thing, but ends up presenting multiple things.

example.top_text: Mom: Bas ek kaam bol rahi hu dhyan se sunna

text_areas.description: Situation or premise where someone promises one thing but gives multiple
